notes: Budgets for scripts/monitoring_report.py. Anchored to live-validated measurements from 2026-07-06 (llm p95 1.45s, time-to-first-audio 1.28-1.44s, TTS RTF 0.18-0.23, zero pipeline errors) with roughly 2x headroom. Changing a budget is a reviewed, committed decision - never a CLI flag.

llm_latency_s_p95.description: p95 LLM response latency across all interactions

time_to_first_audio_s_p95.description: p95 time to first audible TTS chunk (streaming path); budget = the serial-path latency streaming exists to beat

tts_rtf_p95.description: p95 TTS real-time factor, synth time / audio duration (simple path; streaming records have no total audio duration)

pipeline_error_rate.description: failed chunks / total chunks across streaming interactions

chunk_completion_rate.description: played chunks / total chunks across streaming interactions

drift.description: Total variation distance between the emotion-bucket distribution of the current window and all older telemetry. Requires min_samples_per_window on both sides before a verdict is issued.
